captions.instagram:
My father, Norman N. Jemal, was my mentor. We worked together at our family discount store in Spanish Harlem, and in 1976 he opened the first Wiz on Fulton Street.

Today I lead JemRock Organization and BUILT®, a prefabricated modular housing production system unveiled in August 2026.

Two generations, one thread: building.

#FamilyBusiness #Brooklyn #Housing

What did the generation before you build?

captions.linkedin:
Ask the generation before you what they built first. The answers are worth saving.

My father, Norman N. Jemal, was my mentor. We worked together at our family discount store in Spanish Harlem. In 1976, he opened the first Wiz on Fulton Street in Brooklyn.

My own path ran from four stores by 16 to construction, waterfront revitalization and real estate, and now JemRock Organization, where I'm President and CEO. We unveiled BUILT® in August 2026: one mother factory in the US, hundreds of custom pilot factories in the countries that need housing.

#FamilyBusiness #Leadership

What's the best question you've asked a parent or mentor?
